stackDivergence.rationale: Host UTF16 strings, Uint8Array and asynchronous ZIP/SAX bindings replace native component streams and generated token transport at the consumed package boundary.

preservedResponsibilities: ZIP stream/commit binding reuses actual ZIP32 owners. Typed output delegates standard content types to package; per-stream RelId follows OWriteStream_Impl::GetNewRelId.

Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER238 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved.

Content-type reading now returns actual nested initialized Sequence<StringPair> rows; original root growth, append/default assignment, ordered duplicate retention and owned MIME lookup reuse genuine SAL/CPPU owners. WriteContentSequence consumes actual borrowed StringPair fields through AttributeList/SAX events without host pair reconstruction. ZipPackage WriteContentTypes uses original fixed FullPath0/Version1/MediaType2 slots, five actual default pairs, manifest-sized overrides followed by final shrink, original exact comparison and DirectoryHelper split semantics. ZipStorage supplies the original three-slot stream manifest including empty Version. CALC-494/WRITER425 preserve unchanged right output at leading/trailing token boundaries. Native parser short-prefix EOF result is tested through genuine InputSource; direct host XML text does not pass through the byte converter. Actual XStorage/XRelationshipAccess/XWriter services, host relationship output and complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain pending. Native physical ABI/allocation/thread behavior is not certified; file/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.

Actual package READ input now returns a genuine OInputCompStream readonly snapshot owning native MediaType/Compressed/Size/RelationsInfo properties, input and independent current position. Existing asynchronous ZIP bytes remain the transport binding; no fake XStorage, parent, mutex or query provider is introduced. Native parseContentType application uses initialized StringPair rows, ordered defaults then explicit overrides, case-sensitive short-name suffixes, last duplicate assignment and hidden internal content metadata. Missing/broken content metadata and malformed own relationships refuse stream opening. Async initialization caches only immutable fields or an error diagnostic, never a shared owned UNO exception; concurrent/repeated failed opens create/destroy their own exceptions. Writer now retains real XStream and obtains part metadata through UNO_QUERY_THROW XRelationshipAccess; private part relationship mirrors and repeated side-stream parsing are removed. Root storage relationships remain the existing binding. Parent-bound lifetime/disposal, complete XStorage/hierarchical parent graph and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Synchronous JS/native thread/physical ABI/allocation guarantees stay unverified. Existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.

Original standalone OInputSeekStream and ImplInheritanceHelper now provide actual seekable readonly components to Writer SEEKABLEREAD. Additional interface/type-provider query precedes qualified base fallback; type lists retain duplicates and per-specialization class data. Seek operations preserve disposed-before-missing-interface exceptions and native underlying bounds. Flat asynchronous ZIP snapshots bind only the consumed readonly hierarchical open signature; full XStorage/XHierarchicalStorageAccess, parent-bound OWriteStream_Impl/OHierarchyHolder graph, mutex/thread/physical ABI guarantees and complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery policy is unchanged.

Original UNOMemoryStream standalone class now supplies genuine XServiceInfo/XStream/XSeekableInputStream/XOutputStream/XTruncate and ByteReader/ByteWriter, native shared cursor/overwrite/truncate behavior and exact exceptions. Both close methods only reset the cursor (CALC-496/WRITER427), without a corrective disconnected flag. ZipStorage SEEKABLEREAD initializes and rewinds this actual cache; real BinaryXInputStream/BinaryXOutputStream integration is exercised. The primitive vector is lowered to signed typed storage with separate logical length and initial1MiB capacity; indeterminate gap bytes, native noinit/allocation/growth/ABI guarantees remain unverified. Factory registration, parent storage/OWriteStream graph, spill files, complete output serializer/package/model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Browser file/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.

Native serializer byte owners now use genuine SAL ByteSequence/NODEFAULT cache storage, raw nElements mutation and toUnoSequence output aliases. ForMerge/ForSort own actual native sequence values, preserve native realloc/prepend/postpone/sort behavior and copy the merge value before pop. Stack/cache std::shared_ptr lifetime is explicitly lowered to a private local control count with virtual destruction, including failed destination switches. Helper endDocument destroys its moved serializer on success or error. ZipFragmentStream and relationship export consume initialized UNO byte Sequence values; host Uint8Array chunks remain only at the ZIP transport copy boundary. WRITER137/CALC-303 has a local retained-native-value alias witness without a COW correction. Full native output Reference/OWriteStream/parent storage/transaction/service and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Numeric/encoding edge cases, physical allocation/ABI/shared_ptr layout and debug-only guarantees stay unverified. Browser file/persistence policy is unchanged.
omittedResponsibilities: Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified.
Complete native package/service/disconnection/fragment ownership and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain unverified.
